meta.scope: Turkey Batch 4 — Provincial structure (Istanbul, Ankara, Izmir), agriculture, and energy/power densification.

candidates.title: Istanbul Gross Regional Domestic Product
candidates.description: Official GRDP for Istanbul — by far the largest provincial economy, accounting for roughly 29% of national GDP in recent estimates. Dominant services, finance, trade and industrial concentration; global-city node.
candidates.notes: Primary economic-core regional node. Highest single provincial share.

candidates.title: Ankara Gross Regional Domestic Product
candidates.description: Official GRDP for Ankara — the capital and second-largest provincial economy (around 10–11% of national GDP). Strong public administration, services and industrial presence.

candidates.title: Izmir Gross Regional Domestic Product
candidates.description: Official GRDP for Izmir — the third-largest provincial economy and principal Aegean industrial, port and services hub.
referenced_by: Provincial ranking and Aegean regional analysis

candidates.title: Agriculture and crop production statistics
candidates.description: Official volume statistics for cereals, vegetables, fruits and other crops. Wheat, barley, maize, tomatoes, fruits and related products form the core of agricultural output; production is sensitive to climate variability.

candidates.title: Electricity generation and installed capacity statistics
candidates.publisher: Ministry of Energy and Natural Resources / related
candidates.description: Installed generation capacity and electricity production by source (coal, natural gas, hydro, wind, solar, geothermal, etc.). Capacity exceeds 120 GW; the mix is diversifying with strong growth in renewables.

candidates.title: Turkey provincial–agriculture–energy densification meta-node
candidates.publisher: Derived from TurkStat and energy sources
candidates.description: Meta-node binding Istanbul, Ankara and Izmir GRDP series, agriculture and crop production statistics, and electricity generation/capacity into a coherent spatial–primary–energy layer.
referenced_by: All detailed nodes in this batch
